These disposable test-only TLS fixtures serve the loopback federation outbox mock. They grant no production trust. `outbox-test-ca.pem` is the public certificate of the issuing test CA (its private key was discarded after signing); `outbox-test-cert.der` / `outbox-test-key.der` are the leaf, valid for 127.0.0.1 only. Run federation_outbox with `SSL_CERT_FILE` pointing to `outbox-test-ca.pem`, alongside `COLAND_TEST_DATABASE_URL`; the suite refuses to run without it.
